content: Beduru Dogholonyi Goudaghawo
Niudude xiawu 3 jienni onxian gieku shihoude BeduruYaheiyaghala mechide echiwo.
Niekozi kun olusanse dogholon wo. Niudunie kunla qienliezhi mechii wijien konde teizhi wijiense orochen kunlase xiahua giezhi baer ghuizho. Hhe wijienyi nierei Seighan wijien giene.
Hhe kun Beduru, Yaheiyaghala orokui chanladene xiahua giezhi baer kerezho.
Beduru, Yaheiyaghala hhei xianxide uzhedene Beduru kieliewo, "Chi bijienyi uzhe."
Hhe kun hhelai xianxide uzhezhi sumulase yama kerene giezho.
Beduru kieliewo, "Made antan, miengu uwoma, bikune chade ogiye. Bi Nasale kun Ersa Mexihai niereghala kielieye, 'Chi bosidene yo!'"
Ingiedene hhei borun khase feizhi bosizheghawo. Hhei gugieni, konni deigo goudazhi lilian orowo.
Jiuli bosi ire, beidene yo qiiwo. Hhelare hhantu mechide orokude yozho, jiulizho, Hudade doulazho.
Kunla hhe yozhi Hudade doulasanyi chanlawo.
Hheshi mechini Seighan wijien konde sousan ghuichen bikuni mejiedene hhe goudasan shiqinde ghaniradei uzhe beizho.
Beduru Sulumaneni Zoulan Doura Jianjizho
Hhe kun Beduru, Yaheiyaghalai barei beikude olon kunla holuzhi hhende ire ghanirawo. Hheshi zhen Sulumaneni zoulan doura wo.
Beduru chanladene bexinlade kieliewo, "Isilie kunla, ta yale ene shiqinde ghanirazho? Ta bijienyi yangiezhi uzhezho? Ta sumulase bijien goya nenli, xienliantu zhugheghalane ene kunyi yoghawo giezhou?
Iburaheimu, Isaghei, Yagebui Huda, mai xienrenlai Huda goya hoji Ersai kuaizho. Ene Ersashi ta Biladode jiuizhi ogidene Bilado jiejin giezhi hhei andaghane giese ta fandui giesan hhe wo.
Ta zhiguitu, gou kunyi ulie keredene kun alasan kunyi andagha giezhi xiahua giewo.
Ta alasanshi aminni Ezhan wo. Huda hhei fugusan kun dundase aminne olughawo. Bijien ene shiqinde ganzhen beine.
Ta tanizhi chanlasan ene kunde Ersai niere lilian oroghawo. Ersai xianxin gieku xinyanghala ene kunyi tai melie qienbu goudaghawo.
Gaijiula, ta noyenlane mutun mejie dazhi qingiezhi giesei bi mejiene.
Huda eqighanse jien xienzhilani tungo giezhi Mexiha shouku giekui kieliewo. Ede qimutui gholuwo.
Ingiese ta geizhen giezhi Hudai miende khareizhi irendu. Tai zuini widaghane.
Ingiese futanni shihou Ezhanyi hhense irene. Huda eqighanse jinjisan Mexihai tande oluzhi ireghane. Hheshijiu Ersa wo.
Zhen Huda eqighandei zhiguitu xienzhilane tungo giezhi kieliesan mutun duyani cunxin goudaghaku shihou olutula Ersa Mexiha bixi asiman jiere feiliene.
Musa kieliezhi Ezhan Huda tai dundase bi mutun nie xienzhi khizheghane. Hhe yan kieliese ta man chenliendu.
Kien ene xienzhii kielienyi ulie chenliese Huda bexinlane dundase widaghane giezho.
Samuerse kaishi giezhi hhei khuinadedu alinie xienzhiliuzhe ene udulani shiqinyi kieliezhi daowo.

Tashi hhe xienzhilai houdei wo. Huda tai xienrenlade yenjisan kielienni taye jienliewo. Huda Iburaheimude ingie kielie goudaghazho, 'Zemin jieredu soyuji minzulade chii houdeini yenyinzhe fuqi irene.'
Huda hojine bosizheghadene peizhi xien tande iregha, tai alinie kunniliuzhe doghunnilase likai gieghazhi tande fuqi ogiwo."
